title: dendranthema zawadzkii var. campanulatum
intro: Dendranthema zawadzkii var. campanulatum, commonly known as Campanula Flowered Chrysanthemum or Alpine Chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dendranthema zawadzkii var. campanulatum include wound healing, anti-tumor, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents present in this plant may also contribute to its potential in managing cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, and other health conditions.
